name: A Date with Chair-Kun
source:
Chair-Kun asked you on a date, you are going to live it through the eyes of Chair-Chan (nameable), influence the ending of it by choosing a lot of things!

[Edited from [url=https://natsbarnett.itch.io/a-date-with-chair-kun]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
椅子君向你发出了约会邀请！你将从椅子酱（可自定义姓名）的视角体验这场约会，通过各式各样的选择，影响最终结局！

[摘编自[url=https://natsbarnett.itch.io/a-date-with-chair-kun]Itch.io[/url]]
